data.title: Home visit for care needs assessment (Begutachtung Pflegebedürftigkeit)
data.summary: The Medizinischer Dienst Beispielland (MD), commissioned by Nele Musterkamp's long-term care insurance fund (Pflegekasse), has scheduled a home visit by assessor Frau Rehberg on 26 August 2026 at 10:30 at Ahornring 9 to assess her need for long-term care.
data.explanation: The MD is the medical assessment service that decides, on behalf of your care insurance fund, whether and how much care support you qualify for. An assessor will visit your home at the stated appointment to evaluate your situation, so prepare doctor's reports, your medication plan and, if you keep one, a care diary, and ideally have your caregiver present. If you cannot attend, call the MD immediately to reschedule, since without this visit your care insurance fund cannot decide on your care level.
